Elena CSM: Heads-up — ArborPay QBR scheduled for Wed 03/22 10:00 PT. We need slides + exec alignment. Draft deck uploaded here: https://redwood-internal/slides/arborpay_qbr_v0. Please add asks, risks, and any data by EOD Tue.
Sam AE: Got it. I'll take the renewal-risk slide and recommended renewal stance. Will add bullets by EOD today. :white_check_mark:
Riley SE: I'll add the performance metrics. Can someone confirm timeframe? 90 days? I'll pull p50/p95 latency, token cost trend, and cache hit rate graphs.
Jordan PM: 90d is good. I'll include a short roadmap slide and a one-slide incident recap (recent latency spike + mitigation).
Mike CS Ops: I'll pull adoption KPIs (active routes, embedding adoption, config retention). ETA tomorrow noon — will paste screenshots.
Elena CSM: Also need a one-slide "asks for the execs" — clear asks (budget, timeline, support). @Sam AE you'll propose pricing/renewal ask.
Sam AE: Yep — proposal + recommended next steps. Also will add a risk mitigation plan for potential churn drivers.
Riley SE: Quick ask — can we run a 30-min dry run Thu 03/16 11:00 PT (demo + slides)? I can present the technical bits.
Elena CSM: Sounds good. @Riley SE please send calendar invite. I'll invite ArborPay's VP Eng and CTO once Sam confirms.
Jordan PM: Action list (quick):
1) Slides (master deck) — owner: Elena CSM — due Tue EOD
2) Renewal risk + recommendation — owner: Sam AE — due Mon EOD
3) Performance graphs (90d) — owner: Riley SE — due Mon noon
4) Adoption KPIs + screenshots — owner: Mike CS Ops — due Tue noon
5) Incident recap + roadmap slide — owner: Jordan PM — due Tue EOD
6) Dry run invite + agenda — owner: Riley SE — send by Thu morning
Elena CSM: I'm adding a simple RAG renewal likelihood field to the cover slide. Please add 1-2 sentence rationale under your slides.
Riley SE: Adding graphs now. Quick data note: token cost trend uses normalized unit cost (USD per 1k tokens). Will label axes.
Mike CS Ops: Pulling dashboard widgets — will paste links to the widgets so we can keep them live in the deck.
Sam AE: For execs, recommend we propose a 12-month Dedicated offer with a 10% discount in exchange for preferred support. I'll draft language.
Elena CSM: Thanks. One more: can someone drop a short "IC level ask" line for the prep doc (what we expect from VP Eng vs CTO) so we can prep talking points?
Jordan PM: I'll add "Roadmap ask = sign-off on q3 infra scaling" and "Tech ask = dedicated pre-prod access for ArborPay" as two bullets.
Riley SE: Calendar invite sent for Thu 03/16 11:00 PT (30m) — dry run. Please RSVP.
Elena CSM: Quick statuses: Sam -> drafting renewal slide; Riley -> graphs in progress; Mike -> dashboards ETA noon; Jordan -> roadmap/incidents draft.
Sam AE: FYI I'll also add an optional follow-up workshop offer for their infra team.
Elena CSM: Perfect. I'll consolidate into v2 of the deck after everyone adds content.
deploy-bot: Deck version v1.1 uploaded by elena_csm: https://redwood-internal/slides/arborpay_qbr_v1.1 (audit log attached)
Mike CS Ops: Uploaded live widgets and two screenshots. Links inside the deck.
Elena CSM: Final reminder — please finish your pieces by Tue EOD so I can run through and lock slides Wed morning. Thanks everyone! :pray:
